name: Devx Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  devx_tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Get latest release tag
        id: get_release
        run: |
          RELEASE=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)
          echo "release=$RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Exit if no releases
        if: steps.get_release.outputs.release == ''
        run: |
          echo "No releases found. Skipping dev tag creation."
          exit 0

      - name: Determine next dev tag
        id: dev_tag
        run: |
          RELEASE="${{ steps.get_release.outputs.release }}"
          echo "Release: $RELEASE"

          # Fetch all tags
          git fetch --tags

          # List existing dev tags for this release
          TAGS=$(git tag -l "${RELEASE}.dev*" | sort -V)
          echo "Existing dev tags: $TAGS"

          if [ -z "$TAGS" ]; then
            NEXT=1
          else
            LAST=$(echo "$TAGS" | tail -n1)
            NUM=${LAST##*.dev}
            NEXT=$((NUM + 1))
          fi

          echo "next=$NEXT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create and push dev tag
        run: |
          RELEASE="${{ steps.get_release.outputs.release }}"
          NEXT="${{ steps.dev_tag.outputs.next }}"
          TAG="${RELEASE}.dev${NEXT}"
          echo "Attempting to create tag $TAG"

          MAX_RETRIES=5
          RETRIES=0

          while [ $RETRIES -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; do
            # Create annotated tag
            git tag -a "$TAG" -m "dev tag $TAG" HEAD

            # Push tag
            if git push origin "$TAG"; then
              echo "Tag $TAG pushed successfully."
              exit 0
            else
              echo "Tag $TAG already exists. Incrementing and retrying."
              NEXT=$((NEXT + 1))
              TAG="${RELEASE}.dev${NEXT}"
              RETRIES=$((RETRIES + 1))
            fi
          done

          echo "Failed to create a unique dev tag after $MAX_RETRIES attempts."
          exit 1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
